name: arrangeable-grid
title: Arrangeable Grid
description: Inventory-style grid of fixed slots, any size from 1 × 10 to 5 × 5: drag to move or swap, stack with a merge rule, per-slot accept rules, linked grids in one root, drop targets such as a trash button, sources that drag new items in, files dropped from the desktop, drag out or Delete to remove, full keyboard support, and a headless useArrangeableGrid hook for adding, removing, counting and sorting items from code.
